rules: 1. hasInternationalCooperation(X, Y) :- isPartnerOf(X, Z), hasInternationalCooperation(Z, Y)
2. hasInternationalCooperation(X, Y) :- participatesInProject(X, Z), hasInternationalCooperation(Z, Y)
3. hasInternationalCooperation(X, Y) :- memberOfConsortium(X, Z), hasInternationalCooperation(Z, Y)
4. hasInternationalCooperation(X, Y) :- collaboratesWith(X, Z), hasInternationalCooperation(Z, Y)
5. hasInternationalCooperation(X, Y) :- affiliatedWith(X, Z), hasInternationalCooperation(Z, Y)
